title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the containers:view permission could access…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, users with a role granting the containers:view permission could access automation history for containers beyond their assigned label or tenant scope. This exposure includes action parameters, connector result summaries, and other investigation and response activities. The issue arises because the REST API checks container view permissions but does not enforce scope restrictions on automation history access.
